note: Never ends a syllable: ăn (an), to eat.

meaning: uh, as in cup, kept short
note: Never ends a syllable: chân (chuhn), foot; leg.

meaning: ey, as in hey, with no glide
oh, as in go, with no glide
the vowel of her, with no r
oo said with spread lips, as in a smile
d, as in dog: the crossed d

note: da (zah), skin. Never the d of dog: that is đ.

meaning: z, the same sound as d (Hanoi)
between d and t, no puff of air
ch, a little softer than English
t with a puff of air
a soft throat sound, as in Scottish loch
z again: gi, d and r sound alike (Hanoi)

note: đ + o, dipping tone (ỏ). đ is d, o is aw.
đ + â + t. â is uh, the last t is not released.
d + ê. d is z, ê is ey.
r + e, dipping tone (ẻ). r is z, e is eh.
x + e + m. x is s.
th + ơ. th is t with a puff, ơ is er with no r.
ph + ô, rising tone (ố). ph is f.
nh + o, dipping tone (ỏ). nh is ny.
kh + o, rising tone (ó). kh is the throat sound of loch.
gi + ơ, falling tone (ờ). gi is z.
ch + ư, broken tone (ữ). ư is oo with spread lips.
tr + ă + m. tr is ch, ă is a short a.
c + â + n, falling tone (ầ). c is k, â is uh.
h + ô, falling tone (ồ). ô is oh, with no glide.
A small hook, like a question mark with no dot: sửa (suu-uh?), to fix.
The only mark under the vowel: bạn (bahn.), friend.
ch + a, level tone: no mark, no symbol in the line.
l + à, falling tone. Compare lá (leaf) and lạ (strange).
v + ề, falling tone. ê keeps its hat; the tone mark goes on top.
tr + à, falling tone. Same sound as cha with a falling tone.
đ + á, rising tone. Compare đã (already).
m + ở, dipping tone. The hook sits on ơ.
c + ả, dipping tone. Compare cá (fish).
đ + ã, broken tone. Compare đá (ice).
ch + ợ, heavy tone: the dot goes under the vowel.

meaning: the k sound, before a, o, u and the rest
the k sound, before i, e and ê
the g of get, before i, e and ê
ng, as in singer, even at the start
the same ng, before i, e and ê

note: ng + o + n. It starts with ng, as in singer.
nh + a + nh: nh at the start is ny, at the end -anh is aing.
l + a + nh, heavy tone. -anh is aing.
s + a + ch, rising tone. -ach is aik, cut short.
th + i + ch, rising tone. -ich is ik.
h + o + c, heavy tone. Stop ending: only / or . is possible.
đ + e + p, heavy tone. The p is not released.
t + ô + t, rising tone. Stop ending.
m + ă + t, rising tone. Stop ending.
n + o + ng, rising tone. Not a stop ending: ng can take any tone.

meaning: ee gliding to uh, with a sound after it
ee gliding to uh, at the end of a syllable
oo gliding to uh, with a sound after it
oo gliding to uh, at the end of a syllable
uu gliding to uh, with a sound after it
uu gliding to uh, at the end of a syllable

note: m + ai: long ah, then ee.
c + ay: short a, then ee.
c + ao: long ah, then oo.
m + au, falling tone: short a, then oo.
đ + âu: short uh, then oo.
m + ây: short uh, then ee.
m + eo, falling tone: eh, then oo.
m + ơi, rising tone: er, then ee. The line writes ơi as uhy.
t + iê + n, falling tone. One syllable.
b + ia: the pair iê, spelled ia at the end.
ch + uô + i, rising tone. One syllable.
n + ươ + c, rising tone. One syllable.
m + ưa: the pair ươ, spelled ưa at the end.
x + oai, falling tone: o is a quick w, swahy.
kh + oe, dipping tone: o is a quick w, khweh.
